#!/bin/bash
# post-checkout hook: 代码仓库切换版本时，自动将配置仓库(.nanobot)切到对应版本
# 映射规则：区间覆盖 — 以配置仓库中"最后一个 ≤ 代码版本日期"的里程碑为映射目标
# 使用 git reset --hard 确保配置仓库干净切换

CONFIG_REPO="/root/.nanobot"

PREV_HEAD="$1"
NEW_HEAD="$2"
BRANCH_FLAG="$3"

# 只在切换分支/标签时触发，跳过文件checkout (BRANCH_FLAG=0)
[ "$BRANCH_FLAG" = "0" ] && exit 0

# 获取新HEAD的标签名（优先取v-stable-*）
CODE_TAG=$(git tag --points-at "$NEW_HEAD" | grep '^v-stable-' | sort -V | tail -1)

if [ -z "$CODE_TAG" ]; then
    echo "[config-lock] 无v-stable标签，跳过配置同步"
    exit 0
fi

# 从代码标签提取日期数字 (YYYYMMDD)，兼容非标准后缀如 v-stable-20260517-plus-fixes
CODE_DATE=$(echo "$CODE_TAG" | grep -oP '\d{8}' | head -1)

cd "$CONFIG_REPO" || exit 1

# ============ 更新 version-lock.json ============
_update_version_lock() {
    local CODE_TAG="$1"
    local CODE_COMMIT="$2"
    local CODE_SHORT=$(echo "$CODE_COMMIT" | cut -c1-7)
    local TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
    local LOCK_FILE="$CONFIG_REPO/version-lock.json"
    cat > "$LOCK_FILE" << EOF
{
  "synced_code_version": "$CODE_TAG",
  "synced_code_commit": "$CODE_SHORT",
  "synced_at": "$TODAY",
  "note": "Auto-maintained. Updated by post-checkout hook or manually."
}
EOF
    echo "[config-lock] version-lock.json updated → $CODE_TAG ($CODE_SHORT)"
}

# ============ 策略1：配置仓库有同名标签 → 直接reset ============
if git tag -l "$CODE_TAG" | grep -q .; then
    git reset --hard "$CODE_TAG" --quiet 2>/dev/null
    CONFIG_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
    echo "[config-lock] $CODE_TAG → .nanobot $CODE_TAG ($CONFIG_COMMIT) [exact]"
    _update_version_lock "$CODE_TAG" "$NEW_HEAD"
    exit 0
fi

# ============ 策略2：区间覆盖 — 找最后一个 ≤ CODE_DATE 的里程碑commit ============
MAPPED_TAG=""
MAX_DATE=0

for tag in $(git tag -l 'v-stable-*'); do
    tag_date=$(echo "$tag" | grep -oP '\d{8}$')
    if [ -n "$tag_date" ] && [ "$tag_date" -le "$CODE_DATE" ] && [ "$tag_date" -gt "$MAX_DATE" ]; then
        MAX_DATE=$tag_date
        MAPPED_TAG=$tag
    fi
done

if [ -n "$MAPPED_TAG" ]; then
    git reset --hard "$MAPPED_TAG" --quiet 2>/dev/null
    CONFIG_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
    echo "[config-lock] $CODE_TAG → .nanobot $MAPPED_TAG ($CONFIG_COMMIT) [range覆盖]"
    _update_version_lock "$CODE_TAG" "$NEW_HEAD"
    exit 0
fi

# ============ 策略3：找不到里程碑标签 → 回退到日期最近commit ============
if [ -n "$CODE_DATE" ]; then
    YEAR=${CODE_DATE:0:4}
    MONTH=${CODE_DATE:4:2}
    DAY=${CODE_DATE:6:2}
    TARGET_COMMIT=$(git log --all --format="%H %ai" --until="$YEAR-$MONTH-$DAY 23:59:59" | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')
    if [ -n "$TARGET_COMMIT" ]; then
        git reset --hard "$TARGET_COMMIT" --quiet 2>/dev/null
        CONFIG_SHORT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
        echo "[config-lock] $CODE_TAG → .nanobot $CONFIG_SHORT (fallback: nearest to $CODE_DATE)"
        _update_version_lock "$CODE_TAG" "$NEW_HEAD"
        exit 0
    fi
fi

echo "[config-lock] $CODE_TAG → 未找到对应配置版本"
